Name: Pierre's Grocery store
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Pierre's Grocery Store Requirements: Content Patcher
This mod turns Pierre's Seed Shop into a local grocery shop. Pierre now sells crops and forgeable items based off NPC's loved items, dialogue, festivals and items in his store. Store items are really hard to tell, so I took my best guess and some I have no guess at all for.
You can choose to have the items sold all year or by season.
